snippet.title: No Asteroids | Free Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
The free demo of No Asteroids is out on Steam now.

An asteroid of five million cubic meters is flying to Earth. You have 90 days to dig it away. You start with a pickaxe.

The demo is the first 15 days. Your progress goes on in the full game.
The full game comes out on November 24.

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/No_Asteroids/
